summary: 25-year-old hiker fell 600-800 feet and died while hiking with friends near Silverton
notes: Exact peak/route not specified in article; victim from Cookeville, TN | advnture narrative (opened run 542): 25-YO day hiker fell 600-800 ft off the Snowdon Peak ridgeline near Silverton; declared deceased ~5:45 p.m.; five companions unharmed; Silverton Medical Rescue + San Juan County SO responded, Flight for Life medics on scene.
